pet_notes: A compact original moon-white cloud cat with one-piece pear-shaped body, tiny attached paws, two rounded triangular attached ears with pale sky-blue inner tips, large dark-navy physical eyes, a tiny curved mouth, and a subtle mint-blue belly glow. Symmetric, no tail, no props, no logo, no text, no holes or detached parts.
